mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings deterioration, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic contraction that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand that precedes corporate revenue contraction, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 5-year moving average signal a strengthening labor market that supports corporate hiring and earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index, 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that precedes corporate output reductions, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%), a federal funds rate below 3.0% signals aggressive monetary easing that compresses discount rates and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a synchronized consumer and housing sector slowdown that triggers equity sell-offs, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month.
